'''Lowhhrick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].

==Biography==
[[File:Lowhhrick-EdgeOfTheEmpire.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lowhhrick in battle]]
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Lowhhrick was born on the forest [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of his [[Species/Legends|species]]. Whilst he lived on Kashyyyk he served as a warrior, but both his [[Lowhhrick's sister|sister]] and [[Lowhhrick's nephew|nephew]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] raiding parties, who had traveled from the nearby planet [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] to hunt Wookiees for sport. Swearing he would claim vengeance Lowhhrick attempted to hunt down his relatives killers, but he was instead captured and forced into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], fighting as a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] for the amusement of others. The Wookiee eventually achieved enough notoriety in battle to attract the attention of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who worked out of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The Hutt purchase Lowhhrick and made him regularly fight gladiators belonging to the criminal's associates as a way of asserting dominance, sometimes also using him as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] during business meetings. The Wookiee eventually became Teemo's favorite gladiator, and after any fights Lowhhrick took part in he would be regularly treated by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Doctor/Legends|medic]] [[41-VEX]] for his injuries. Lowhhrick struck up a friendship with the droid, and also befriended [[Oskara]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in Teemo's employ. When Oskara decided she wanted out of the Hutt crime lord's employ Lowhhrick agreed to help as long as he too was freed along with 41-VEX. The trio agreed to work together, with the droid also introducing the Teemo's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Pash]] into the scheme and Oskara bringing in a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] named [[Sasha]] and Teemo's [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Mathus]].<ref name="LCS" /> The group fled [[Teemo's palace/Legends|Teemo's palace]] with Teemo's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] thugs soon giving chase through the streets of Mos Shuuta. To avoid the enforcers the escapees ducked into the [[Mos Shuuta Grill & Cantina]].

{{RPG}}
The renegades hid themselves within the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and when the Gamorreans entered the group ambushed them, successfully defeating the six enforcers. After the fight ended the cantina's [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Vik (bartender)|Vik]], told Lowhhrick and his companions about the ''[[Krayt Fang]]'', a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] belonging to Teemo's Trandoshan bounty hunter [[Trex]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was parked in [[Landing Bay Aurek]] but lacked a functioning [[Hypermatter reactor igniter]] and so was unable to take off. At Vik's suggestion the group then made their way to a a [[Vorn's junk shop|junk shop]] in Mos Shuuta owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Vorn]]. They successfully acquired the necessary igniter for the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]], despite the only part available already being promised to Trex. Next they gained entry to the [[Mos Shuuta landing control]] past a pair of [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] and managed to successfully deactivate the landing clutches in Landing Bay Aurek, despite the presence of a number of technicians and their overseer, [[Brynn]]. With all the preparations for leaving made, Lowhhick and his fellow escapees began to make their way to the Landing Bay, however on the way they encountered a squad of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]]. Fighting their way through the Stormtroopers, the group eventually reached the Landing Bay and after defeating Trex on board his ship they installed the igniter and fled.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lowhhrick first appeared as one of the pre-made characters in ''[[Escape from Mos Shuuta]]'' the adventure included with the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|beginner's game]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' a roleplaying game by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] released in [[2013]]. He was then mentioned in the follow up adventure ''[[The Long Arm of the Hutt]]''.
